critical_code_review_comments: GRIQuestionnaire.js still contains an obsolete hidden Dialog (`<Dialog open={false}>`) that renders `historyDialog.history.length`; fetchHistory and onOpenChange set historyDialog without `history`, causing undefined-length crash.
GRIQuestionnaire.js size is 1155 lines, exceeding maintainability guideline; history rendering exists in multiple places, increasing chance of state-shape drift bugs.

rca of the issue: RCA: state-shape mismatch in GRIQuestionnaire historyDialog. Initial state includes `history: []`, but fetchHistory sets `{open:true, questionKey}` and QuestionVersionHistory close handler sets `{open:false, questionKey:null}`; obsolete hidden Dialog still evaluates `historyDialog.history.length`, causing crash when `history` is absent. Mitigation: enforce consistent state shape (always include history array) or remove obsolete hidden dialog path and keep only QuestionVersionHistory component.
